fusions.name: Drop on a Thread
fusions.desc: Drops you onto a target up to 6 tiles away for a chop that deals 13 damage and slows it by 30% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrapped and Felled
fusions.desc: A chop on an enemy at or below 25% health that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction on it, adding 2 times their remaining damage to the blow. The health threshold rises with each rank.

fusions.name: Tripwire Blade
fusions.desc: Strings a bladed tripwire on the nearest enemy that waits 30 seconds; the first enemy to come within 3 tiles takes 20 damage in a blast 2 tiles across.

fusions.name: Hung by a Thread
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge rolls your dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.
